rules.description: Organization ownership required for all actions endpoints (secrets, variables, runners)
rules.condition: User is not org owner AND not site admin

rules.description: Variable names must match pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ (case insensitive), cannot start with GITEA_/GITHUB_, cannot be 'CI'
rules.condition: Name doesn't match pattern OR has forbidden prefix OR equals CI

rules.code_snippet: if utf8.RuneCountInString(data) > VariableDataMaxLength { return nil, util.NewInvalidArgumentErrorf("data too long") }

rules.description: Variable description is truncated to 4096 runes (not rejected)

rules.action: Name is converted to uppercase before storage

rules.description: Variable data has EOL normalized before storage
rules.code_snippet: v, err := actions_model.InsertVariable(ctx, ownerID, repoID, name, util.NormalizeStringEOL(data), description)

rules.description: Creating a variable that already exists returns 409 Conflict
rules.condition: Variable with same name exists for this owner
rules.action: Return 409 Conflict with 'variable name already exists' message

rules.description: UpdateVariable uses path param name as default if body name is empty
Registration token reuses existing active token if available
rules.condition: Latest token exists AND is active
rules.action: Return existing token without creating new one
rules.code_snippet: if errors.Is(err, util.ErrNotExist) || (token != nil && !token.IsActive) { token, err = actions_model.NewRunnerToken(...) }

rules.description: Creating new runner token deactivates all existing tokens for same owner/repo
rules.action: UPDATE all existing tokens for owner/repo to is_active=false, then INSERT new token

rules.description: Runner access is scoped by EditableInContext - runner must belong to the org
rules.action: Return 404 'No permission to access this runner'
rules.code_snippet: if ownerID > 0 && r.OwnerID == ownerID { return true }

rules.description: Runner status is computed from LastOnline/LastActive timestamps, not stored
rules.condition: LastOnline > 1 minute ago = offline; LastActive > 10 seconds ago = idle; else = active
rules.action: Status is dynamically computed on each API response
